name: uk.co.cybercentry/b20-verification
title: Cybercentry B20 Token Verification
description: Can you actually sell it? Verify a B20 tokenized stock on Base before you buy: pool-hook honeypots, whitelisted exits, freeze-and-seize, live pauses, fakes and issuer controls. Also settles any token address — a quote asset, a basket, an ERC-4626 wrapper — against the issuer's published tokenized-stock list and reads what it is a claim on. $1 USDC per verification; reading a finished report is free.
